escalation_note: six 900 dpi tight --value crops used as GEOMETRY proofs, not glyph re-reads: p9 rows 1-2 (1,000.00 / 300.00) and p10 rows 1, 4 and 5 (747.61 / 22.94 / 100.00), plus one crop of p10's band [16.15,19.41] which resolved to the printed GRAY SPACER strip and is what caught a one-band off-by-one in the p10 frame before it was recorded. Both schedules are typed, so no amount needed a legibility escalation.

9.measure_note: ROTATED landscape sheet, so axis='x': the printed ROW separators are the vertical rules and the column separators the horizontal ones. Column rules by dark-run projection over the table x-extent (12-88%), identical at every coverage 0.35-0.85: 5.70 / 16.39 / 58.52 / 88.80 / 96.93 = Amount | Address | Name of Contributor | Date; cell = the Amount band [5.70,16.39]. Row rules over the table y-extent (6-96%) at coverage 0.55 and stable to 0.35 — 27 rules, of which 6.15 is the page-edge line, 8.62 the table's left border, 11.88 the end of the printed label column and 15.15 the end of the gray spacer strip; the 23 bands from 15.15 to 89.68 are the printed data rows, ALL DETECTED, none extrapolated. Rows 1 and 2 were proved with 900 dpi make_snippet --value crops that reproduced 1,000.00 and 300.00.

10.measure_note: Same rotated geometry, axis='x'. Column rules over x 12-88%, identical at every coverage: 4.50 / 15.18 / 34.05 / 44.73 / 90.09 / 98.25 = Amount | Purpose | City | Person-or-Organization | Date; cell = [4.50,15.18]. Row rules at coverage 0.65 (stable 0.45-0.85). CAUTION recorded because it nearly cost an off-by-one: this page's printed label column is TALLER than Form A's (the 'Date of Expenditure' header wraps to three lines), so the first band after the table border, [16.15,19.41], is the GRAY SPACER, not data — a 900 dpi crop of it returned the blank gray strip while [19.41,22.56] returned 747.61. Data row 1 therefore begins at 19.41; the 23 bands 19.41-92.68 are all detected, none extrapolated. Rows 1, 4 and 5 were crop-proved (747.61 / 22.94 / 100.00).

notes: Bahram Rahimzadegan, 'Weber County Recorder Surveyors Office', 2024 cycle, '7 days before convention' report, signed 4/7/2024. Both schedules are TYPED (not handwritten) — unusual for this corpus and the reason confidence is uniform medium with no legibility escalation; SCHEMA §6 still caps a page image at the OCR tier so nothing is marked high. Page ORDER is the form order here: cover p8, Form A p9, Form B p10. The candidate's street address on the cover is BLACKED OUT by the county before publication — the government's own redaction, preserved and not recovered (PRIVACY.md). Note a printed-form defect in the source, not a transcription issue: the 2024 cover's December-5 checkbox text says 'through December 31, 2022' (the county reused the 2022 form text); it is unticked here and does not affect any figure.
